sources.summary: Photoshop grants exclusive modal access. Cancellation must interrupt work; suspended history can commit or roll back. A normal modal return commits pending suspended history; exceptions cancel it. Other plugins cannot observe batchPlay notifications during noninteractive modal scope.

Invalid argument shape rejects the Promise, but a valid command with an unavailable target can resolve to an error descriptor. Results align with command order. ID references survive insertions that shift indices. Silent execution reports errors; dontDisplay may still show UI.
Applying marked redactions and sanitizing hidden information are separate steps; hidden metadata, comments and layers must also be addressed.

proof_deltas.proposal: Attach cancellation/undo/failure ordering proof to existing obligations, without copying Adobe modal exclusivity as Studio architecture.
proof_deltas.counterexample: Two actors edit separate documents; an import for A is cancelled after expensive preparation while B commits an edit. A must not leak partial authority or erase B; lease/byte permits must reclaim; restart re-read must show only committed state.
proof_deltas.minimum_proof: Independent validator drives production typed/Argus routes, cancels at preparation/promotion boundaries, checks canonical SurrealDB/EventLedger and history, repeats idempotency key after restart. Observe actual resource high-water marks and bounded rejection rather than only queue item count.
proof_deltas.scope: Preserve concurrency in Studio; Adobe's single modal writer is evidence of original behavior, not a mandate for a global Studio lock.

proof_deltas.proposal: Separate command transport success, per-item operation result, warning/loss disposition and promotion success in differential workflow evidence.
proof_deltas.counterexample: A batch targets an object deleted after inspection. A resolved transport response or screenshot cannot certify edit success; a missing-target result must prevent a fabricated success receipt.
proof_deltas.minimum_proof: Production negative case binds immutable object/document IDs and revision/epoch, asserts typed unavailable/conflict result, no mutation/event beyond declared failed-attempt evidence, and no fallback to active document or shifted index.

proof_deltas.proposal: Require destructive PDF operation proof to inspect saved reachable objects and incremental/embedded history, not only painted output. Map to exact PDF/redaction contract during root consolidation.
proof_deltas.counterexample: A visually redacted string survives in an unused object, attachment, layer, metadata field or prior incremental section.
proof_deltas.minimum_proof: Independent byte/object parser plus separate renderer/text extractor inspect the saved artifact; public PDF security behavior remains explicit. No PDF security/conformance PASS is inferred from a screenshot or exporter self-report.
